chapters: Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr koi'm gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu Amalekitas juruuñ gook gu tanoolh gu Siklag.
Jano' ba' vaik gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' u'va maa'n yooxi' gu Sauul jajannulhi'ñ gu oidha' bhaan mo'o; gio ba' gu Dabii o'lhia'n gu oidha' tu' jix duu tu jiim.
Jano' ba' tɨtda:―¿Jax gu Dabii; gio ba' duukat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'; mi' dhɨr yooxi' gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gio mui'x gu ja'tkam ia'rɨ koko'kam; gio ba' gio gu Sauul gu Jonataan gu mar jix koko'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii mii' dhɨr biapma' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ñɨidhat gu Sauul jix koi gu Jonataan gu mar.
Jano' ba' biapma' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'; gio ba' gu kavɨk gu Gilboa gu ñi'ook gu Sauul ka't bhaan u'u kavɨk aajidha' bhaan gu ja'tkam kavaayo.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ñi' jup tɨɨt; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Soy gu Amalekita.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'ga; na gu' tu' soi'ñ tu' bhaan tu' na gu' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook tu'.
Na gu' tu' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan na gu' bhai'x cham gu tanoolh na jix bhai' duaka' mi' dhɨr; gio ba' kuruun ga'ra' mo'o gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jajannulhi'ñ; gio ba' jix duu gu chichio'ñ mi'p bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai gu Sauul gu Jonataan gu mar gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Israeel; na gu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii mii' dhɨr biapma' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' duukat tu' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu mar ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu Amalekita.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam choo'n jix duñia' gu novɨ na ba' kooda' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Dabii maa'n biipibop; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr naaka'n jix koi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan mo'o gu chin gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' bham; mi' dhɨr gu Yo gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu Sauul gu Jonataan gu mar bɨɨx dhi'.
Ba' jix aa' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Judaa; gio ba' ua'nak u'uan gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Israeel bhaan gɨ' kavɨk gu Koomo jix duñia' jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gat cham jix duñia' gu Askaloon; na gu' cham ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Pilisteos na gu' cham ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu kakkavɨk gu Gilboa tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dhuuk jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' maa'nkar na jix maa; na gu' ka't jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu Sauul na ja'p tu' cham jix duñia' Xoi'kam bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' cham gu ɨ'ɨr koko'kam cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu Jonataan cham pai' dhuuk tu' gu kuchii gu Sauul jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu Sauul gu Jonataan tɨɨdam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' koi'm jix bɨɨx duu; gio ba' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Sauul tu jiim gu ñi'ook bɨɨx jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jonataan jix koi.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' no'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' xibhɨk gu Jonataan gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ka't xoi'kam gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk jix koi gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia'; jano' ba' gu Dabii a'ga; gio ba' duukat jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx gook gu u'vɨ gu Ainoam gu Jesreelita gu Abigail ka't gu u'vɨ gu Nabal gu Karmelo.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu Dabii baidhak gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx jix daa dhi' maa'n bɨɨx ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' jɨ'dɨlh gu ebroon.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu chio'ñ gu Judaa tu jiim gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu vaak gu Judaa; gio ba' jix maa aa'ñdham gu Dabii bham; mi' dhɨr gu Jabes gu Galaad gu ñi'ook gu Sauul.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jabes gu Galaad tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook dhi' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx gu Jawatan gu Sauul jix duñia' jix maa.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r; gio ba' tu' gio xoi'kam dhi' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu noobh gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk; na gu' jix koi gu Sauul gu Jawatan gu vaak gu Judaa jix duñia' Xoi'kam gu gɨ'kora' bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu' gu Abner gu mar gu Ner gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Sauul jix bhɨɨ gu Is-boset gu mar gu Sauul tu' gu ñi'ook vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Galaad bhaan gu Gessuri bhaan gu Jesreel bhaan gu Epraim bhaan gu Benjamiin bhaan bɨx gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk oo'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Is-boset gu mar gu Sauul na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' gook; mi' dhɨr gu vaak gu Judaa gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' ka't jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu tanoolh gu Dabii jix gɨ'kora' gu ebroon bhaan gu vaak gu Judaa kɨɨv gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam masaa'n.
Jano' ba' gu Abner gu mar gu Ner jix buus gu Maanaim gu Gabaoon bɨɨx tu duukam gu Is-boset gu mar gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia tu duukam gu Dabii moor jix duñia' ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook gu Gabaoon; gio ba' na ja'p jum daa'ñ gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abner gu Joab; gio ba' gu Lebaantense jano' biipibop gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan no'ch; mi' dhɨr gu Joab jix aa'; jano' ba' gu Lebaantense.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Benjamiin baasɨ'n gu Is-boset gu mar gu Sauul; gio ba' tu duukam gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ mo'o duiñchu' gu kuchii jano'maram; gio ba' ka't tɨɨgim mii' dhɨr pai' gu elkat-assurim gu Gabaoon.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu Abner gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu tu duukam gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' mi'p vaik gu ma'nkam gu Sarbia; gio ba' gu Joab gu Abisai gu Asael; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Asael ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt na ja'p yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu Asael chɨ'ɨɨk gu Abner jiimchu' bhaan cham gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n kɨɨ'n tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abner gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham tu' gu Asael jix aa'; mi' dhɨr.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abner; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim o'nsop oi'ñdha' biipibop jix bhɨɨ na ba' tu'; gu' gu Asael cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Abner gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'ga gu Asael; na gu' tu' na gu' tu' gu oidha' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu vupui xibhɨk gu Joab.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu naaka'n gu Abner bɨɨx u'u kavɨk jix buus u'u kavɨk jix koi mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx aajidha' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Asael ka't jix koi gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' gu Joab gu Abisai bhiadat gu Abner; na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tas na pai' dhuuk gu Amma vupui bhaan gu Giia ju'ñdharan gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki gu Gabaoon.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Abner gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Abner jix maa jiiñak gu Joab bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kuchii cham ñɨidhat tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx ka'm duuk cham a'ga gu ja'tkam gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Joab jix aa'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook tu' dɨr dhi' gu xibh gu ja'tkam tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Joab gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam cham chɨ'ɨɨk gu Israeel tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Abner gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak ja'tkam bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' bhɨi gu Jordaan bɨx gu Bitroon gu Maanaim.
Jano' ba' gu Joab gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abner bɨx gu ja'tkam tu duukam gu Dabii gu chichio'ñ gu Asael.
Gu' gu' tu duukam gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Benjamiin gu Abner vaik gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ jix koko'; gio ba' gu Asael tukga'n gu taat gu Bet-leem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' gu Joab gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu Sauul gu vaak gu Dabii; gu' gu Dabii gu vaak gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Dabii gu ebroon; gio ba' maa'nkam mar ka't gu Ammoon gu Ainoam gu Jesreelita.
Jano' ba' gook gu Kileab gu Abigail gu u'vɨ gu Nabal gu Karmelo; gio ba' vaik gu Absaloom gu mar gu Maakâ mar u'vɨ gu Talmai gu gɨ'kora' gu Gessur.
Jano' ba' maakobh gu Adoniias gu mar gu aggit; gio ba' jixchamaam gu Sapatiias gu mar gu Abital.
Jano' ba' xijumai gu Jetream gu Egla gu u'vɨ gu Dabii; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' na ja'p ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu Sauul gu Dabii ka't gu Abner jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Sauul jix duñia' gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Rispa mar u'vɨ gu Aja; gio ba' jix aa' gu Is-boset gu Abner; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook kia'mi'ñ gu u'vɨ gu taat.

Ba' jix aa' bhaam gu Abner gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Is-boset; gio ba' jix duñia' tu' mo'o gagai' gu Judaa tu' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx gu vaak gu Sauul gu taat bɨɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx cham tu' dhagia' gu noobh gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr tu' duñia' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ dhi' gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Abner tu' na ja'p tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii cham jix duñia' tu' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam atooxkor gu Dabii bhaan gu Israeel bhaan gu Judaa dɨr gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu Beer-seba.
Na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu Abner na gu'.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Abner gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii baasɨ'n bham; gio ba' gu oidha' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu vupui ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu novɨ ka't bɨndak na ba' tu' bɨx gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨndak ñi'ook na jix bhaan; na pai' dhuuk gu' tu' cham maa'n gu Mikâl mar u'vɨ gu Sauul na pai' dhuuk.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' bhañ gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Is-boset gu mar gu Sauul bham; gio ba' gu u'vɨ gu Mikâl tu' gu ñi'ook gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Is-boset bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu Paltiel gu mar gu Lais.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ ka't bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam joi'ndam bɨɨx ka'm gu Baurim; gio ba' jix aa' gu Abner; mi' dhɨr jiim; jano' ba'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abner bɨɨx daraa gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii jum duu gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook gu Dabii bham; mi' dhɨr gu novɨ tu duukam gu Dabii gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu novɨ gu Pilisteos gu novɨ bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gio gu Abner gu Benjamiin; gio ba' ka't gio gu Abner gu ebroon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii bɨx gu Israeel bɨx gu vaak gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Abner gu Dabii gu ebroon bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' gu Dabii jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abner bɨɨx tɨbiap.

Ba' jix aa' gu Abner gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu jiim gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu Israeel na ba' xoi'kam bɨndak ñi'ook na jix bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook na ja'p jix duu; mi' dhɨr gu Dabii gu Abner ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam gu Dabii gu Joab aajidha' yooxi' baidhak; gu' gu Abner cham ka't bɨɨx gu Dabii gu ebroon tu' ka't jix duñia' ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joab bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Joab bham; gio ba' gu Abner gu mar gu Ner tu' tɨbiap gu gɨ'kora' tu' jix duñia' ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Joab suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Miren dua'ñ tɨbiap gu Abner tu'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't.
Jano' ba' ñɨidhat tu' gu Abner gu mar gu Ner tu' tɨbiap na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maachim gu ñi'ook ba'k bɨx tu' duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joab bɨɨx gu Dabii bhañ bhaan gu Abner suulh dɨr oidha' suudai' gu Sira cham maachim gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Abner gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ebroon jix ai'chdhix gu Joab tɨjɨɨ'ñ ki'ñgob a'gi'ñchu' bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n naaka'n kuiñcha koi'm gu Asael xibhɨk jix koi.
Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi' dhɨr dhi'; gio ba' dhi' tu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨɨx tas gu ɨ'ɨr gu Abner gu mar gu Ner.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan mo'o gu Joab bhaan bɨx gu vaak gu taat; na cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu vaak gu Joab gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨ'ra'n tu' gakiidha' tu' bɨɨx tu' jix duñia' uañi'ñ gu takarui'.
Na gu' gu Joab gu Abisai xibhɨk mu'aa gu Abner na gu' ka't jix koi gu Asael xibhɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gabaoon.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Joab bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jajannulhi'ñ vupui bhaan gu Abner; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Abner gu ebroon; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan tukga'n gu Abner; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gio bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Abner chɨtda; gio ba' jix koi gu Abner na ja'p kuusdaidha'.
Jano' ba' gu noobh cham mi'p gu ñi'ook tu' tɨɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx; gio ba' na ja'p vupui bhaan tomaat gu chichio'ñ; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ja'tkam jix xuaak bhaan.

Jano' ba' na ja'p bɨx gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi gu takarui' gu Dabii gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu Dabii gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' va'k jix duñia' gu tas tu' gu takarui' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam gu vupui; na gu' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vupui bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨx gu Israeel aagɨt mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh cham ka't tɨbiap gu gɨ'kora' gu Abner gu mar gu Ner vaak jodai.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' tu duukam; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'.

Na tu' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu gɨ'kora' Xoi'kam; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Sarbia gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix maa cham bhai' duñia' jurtu'nka'.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu mar gu Sauul gu Abner ka't jix duñia' jix koi gu ebroon gu noobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't bɨx gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu mar gu Sauul gook gu chio'ñ jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chu'p gu tɨɨgɨ' maa'n ka't gu Baana gu Rekâb gu ma'nkam gu Rimmoon gu Beerotita gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin; na gu' gu Beerot ka't bɨɨx gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu Beerotitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Gittaim jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm jano' ba'; gio ba'.

Jano' ba' gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sauul ga'ra' gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt jixchamaam; na pai' dhuuk koi'm gu Sauul gu Jonataan suudai' u'va gu Jesreel jix bhɨɨ jix maa; mi' dhɨr na ja'p bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x; jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Mepi-boset.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rimmoon gu Beerotita gu Rekâb gu Baana jix bɨɨx duu baap jix gɨ' jix tónom gu tanoolh gu vaak gu Is-boset ka't kookos gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' baap tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kai'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Rekâb gu Baana xibhɨk.
Na gu' na ja'p baap gu vaak kua' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim koox mo'o jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu tukaa' gu bhóogɨt vaak ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' aichdhak mo'o gu Is-boset gu Dabii gu ebroon gui'p gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o gu Is-boset gu mar gu Sauul bhaamki'ñdha' kooda'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu Sauul gu kai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Rekâb xibhɨk gu Baana gu ma'nkam gu Rimmoon gu Beerotita; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ bɨx.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk maa'n jix maa jix duñia' bham gu Miren gu Sauul jix koi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu' gu Siklag jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tomaat gu chichio'ñ mu'aa gu chio'ñ jir bhai' gu vaak bhaan jano' cham no'ñ tu' gu ɨ'ɨr gu noobh jix duñia' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa'ñdhix biipibop mu'aa jix duñia' gu noobh tɨɨt jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu ebroon; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ mo'o gu Is-boset gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tukga'n gu Abner gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel gu Dabii gu ebroon tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'ch gu'ch o'oo gu chuukug.

Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook va'k na pai' dhuuk gu Sauul bhaan no'ch tu' jix buusñi gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel tu' ka' bhaan gu Israeel gɨ'kora' ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix duu tɨɨtɨs bɨx daraa gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora' gu ebroon gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bɨɨx ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu ebroon vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu jiim gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Dabii gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' oo'm.
Jano' ba' gu ebroon jix gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Judaa kɨɨv gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam masaa'n; gio ba' gu Jerusalem jix gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook vaik bhaan bɨx gu Israeel gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu gu Jerusalem gu Jebuseo jix daa gu oidha'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Dabii bham; mi' dhɨr tu' cham ba'k jix bhai'x tu' cham gu ñi'ook ñiññia mama'mkulhi'; jano' ba' bham; gio ba' cham jix bhai'x gu Dabii.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Dabii jix bhɨɨ gu kavɨk gu Sioon kiicham gu Dabii.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; gio ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Jebuseo mama'mkulhi' ñiññia gu i'ii'ñ gu Dabii bhaamki'ñ gu Por dhi' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr bai'ñchu' tu' jix bhai'x cham gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Kiudad gu Dabii; gio ba' pai'x xikoolh dɨr gu Millo na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ ka't bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu iram gu gɨ'kora' gu Tiro bhañ gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk tɨ'ya' na ba' vaak jodai gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel ka't oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' xoi'kam gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ gu Jerusalem mi' dhɨr suudai' u'va gu ebroon gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu Sammua gu Sobab gu Nataan gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' gu Ibar gu Elisua gu Nepeg.
Jano' ba' gu Japia gu Elisama gu Eliada gu Elipelet.

Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Pilisteos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam Xoi'kam gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel bɨx gu Pilisteos jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook gu Dabii; gio ba' na ja'p gu Dabii jix kai suudai' u'va gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Pilisteos jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Rapaim.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' tu jiim bhaan gu Pilisteos kapbhai' gu noobh gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Dabii; na gu' tu' na gu' gu ñi'ook kapbhai' gu Pilisteos gu noobh.

Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Dabii gu Baal-perasim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios obhɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan tu' na ja'p gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr dhi' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Baal-perasim.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook duiñxim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Rapaim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; gio ba' cham jix tɨ'ɨ; gu' ɨlhdham vupui bhaan jix duñia'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jaja' jix duñia' jano' ba' tu'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook yooxi' gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Dabii na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' naaka'n gu Pilisteos dɨr gu Gabaa bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gasa.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Israeel gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Dabii ka't bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam ga'ra' baidhak gu Baal gu Judaa na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan ka't gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix vɨɨk bhɨɨk gu vaak gu Abinadab ka't gu Gabaa; gio ba' gu Ussa gu Aio gu ma'nkam gu Abinadab jix vɨɨk.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Abinadab ka't gu Gabaa bɨɨx kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Aio vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx gu u'u ka't; gio ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Nakôn gu Ussa gu novɨ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'; na gu' gu vaakax xiixkai.
Jano' ba' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Ussa tu' naaka'n gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr jix koi ju'ñdharan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios gu Ussa; gio ba' ka't tɨɨgim mii' dhɨr pai' gu Peeres-ussa bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jix ai tu' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios kiicham gu Dabii; gu' gu Dabii gu vaak gu Obed-edom gu Geteo.
Jano' ba' juruuñ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Obed-edom gu Geteo vaik masaa'n; gio ba' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Obed-edom bɨx gu vaak.

Jano' ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Obed-edom bɨx juraa'n kuiñcha kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Obed-edom kiicham gu Dabii bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim gu vaak na jix bhai' gu vaakax gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bɨx gu kavɨk vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ga'ra' tɨi'chu' gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' na ja'p kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham gu Dabii ka't gu Mikâl mar u'vɨ gu Sauul tu jiim dɨr gu ñi'ook jix ñi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bɨɨx bɨx gu kavɨk vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas pai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak zel gu Dabii ka't; gio ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Dabii maa'nkar tai bhaan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu Dabii ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan jix bhai' aa' gu ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨx gu Israeel gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu u'vɨ maa'n gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug suudai' u'va; gio ba' ka't bɨx gu ja'tkam maa'n gu vaak.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii na ba' jix bhai' aa' gu vaak; gio ba' gamai' gu Mikâl gu Dabii jix aa'; mi' dhɨr nɨidhat tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu duukam na ja'p.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa' gu Mikâl; gio ba' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam gu taat bɨx gu vaak jum duu gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' jix duñia' gu vupui; gio ba' vupui bhaan tu ñi'ook vupui bhaan jix duñia' nɨidhat.
Jano' ba' gu Mikâl mar u'vɨ gu Sauul cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu ma'nkam bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh koi'm.
Jano' ba' ka't kua' tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Nataan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' tu' gu jodai' na jix uam gɨ' u'u kavɨk kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Nataan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jiim gu vupui bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Nataan bham.
Jano' ba' tu' tu duukam gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook gu vaak tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak dɨr gu tanoolh gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook vaak zel vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ gu Israeel ka't jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel na ba' a'ga; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' gu vaak gɨ' u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jano' daipu' tu duukam gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer na ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu ja'tkam bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨndak bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' jix gɨ' na ja'p gu tɨɨgɨ' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' pai' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel tu' gu ux na tu ibai' na ba' jix duñia' pai' cham pai' dhuuk ka't tu' na ja'p va'k.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' duñia' maachim tu' gu ñi'ook gu vaak.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh ua'tulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tattat tu' dhi' gu kai' mi' dhɨr tu' ba'k oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim na ba' bɨɨx tas atooxkor oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu taat ka't tu' gu mar; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' cham bhai' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch cham gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' na ba' bɨɨx tas vupui bhaan gu vupui; gio ba' atooxkor ka't dhi'.
Ba' jix aa' jurtu'nka' bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Nataan gu Dabii.
Ba' jix aa' chɨbiapui gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chɨkka jix duñia' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na ba' tu' bɨɨx ka'm.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dhi' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gio tu ñi'ook gu vaak tu duukam; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'xdha' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii a'gi'ñchu' bɨndak tu' jix maati' tu duukam gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' gu i'ii'ñ maachim tu duukam.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch na ja'p tu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios mai' tu' jurtu'nka' bɨx naak bɨɨx naak maatɨt.

Jano' ba' chɨkka na ja'p gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu Israeel gu oidha' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios jum duu gu ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel buimɨi gu oidha' xoi'kam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu Ejipto chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu jiim gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook bhaan tu duukam bhaan gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bɨɨx tas gu vupui jurtu'nka'.
Na ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu vaak tu duukam gu Dabii ka't gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu'.

Na gu' na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naak tu duukam bham; gio ba' gu Yo tu' gu vaak; mi' dhɨr dhi' tu duukam tu' gaagam gu i'ii'ñ na ba' a'ga vupui bhaan tu' dhi' ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook ka't jiimda' tu' tu ñi'ook tu duukam dhi' xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx jano' xoi'kam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak tu duukam na ba' vupui bhaan tu'; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook bɨɨx jix bhai' aa' ka't gu vaak tu duukam na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't gu Dabii naaka'n gu Pilisteos jix duñia'; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii gu Metegamma gu novɨ gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' naaka'n gio gu Moab gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' bɨɨx gook na ba' koi'm na ba' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu gu Moabitas tu duukam bɨtaa'n namki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naaka'n gu Dabii gu adad-eser gu mar gu Reob gu gɨ'kora' gu Soba jiimchu' jix duñia' gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Euprates.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kavaayo gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ tɨɨt; gio ba' gu Dabii jix duñia' bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Siros gu Damasko gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'ua'tɨdham gu adad-eser gu gɨ'kora' gu Soba; gio ba' gu Dabii naaka'n gu Siros gu ñi'ook gook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Siria gu Damasko jix bɨɨx duu gu Siros tu duukam gu Dabii namki'ñdha'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii pai' ka't.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii kutun kavɨk jix uam jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam gu adad-eser gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Beta gu Beerot jɨ'dɨlh gu adad-eser jix bhɨɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Toi gu gɨ'kora' gu amat gu Dabii ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu adad-eser.

Na gu' bhañ gu Toi gu Joram gu mar gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii tulhiiñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai' aa' na gu' ka't bɨɨx gu adad-eser ka't; na gu' gu Toi ka't bhaamki'ñdha' gu adad-eser; mi' dhɨr gu Joram gu novɨ jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx jix toja jodai jix uam jodai ga'ra' bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't.
Jano' ba' gu Siros gu Moabitas gu Ammonitas gu Pilisteos gu Amalekitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu adad-eser gu mar gu Reob gu gɨ'kora' gu Soba.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu Siros naaka'n mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Edom bɨx gu Edom jix dhaas; gio ba' bɨx gu Idumeos jix bɨɨx duu tu duukam gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii pai' ka't.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bhaan bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Dabii gu ñi'ook bɨx bhai' bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu Josapat gu mar gu Ailud.
Jano' ba' gu Sadok gu mar gu Aitud gu Aimelek gu mar gu Abiatar jix duñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu Seraiia ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada ka't bhaan gu Kereteos gu Peleteos; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Dabii jix duñia' chiñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' oi'ñdha' gu vaak gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Jonataan.
Ba' jix aa' ka't tu duukam gu vaak gu Sauul tɨɨt gu Siba na ja'p tɨɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu' gu Siba jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu duukam.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' cham tu' jix duñia' soo'mchulhdhak gu vaak gu Sauul gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu Siba jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu mar gu Jonataan tɨɨt.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duukat gu Siba jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu vaak gu Makîr gu mar gu Amiel gu Lodebar.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii jix bhɨɨ gu vaak gu Makîr gu mar gu Amiel gu Lodebar.

Jano' ba' jix duu tɨbiap gu Mepi-boset gu mar gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sauul gu Dabii o'lhia'n bhaan gu vupui tu' tu jiim; gio ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu Mepi-boset; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam choo'n na gu' tu' tu'r bɨndak xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch xoi'kam gu Jonataan gu taat tu' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu Sauul gu taat; mi' dhɨr tu' jugi bɨɨx tas gu takarui' gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' chɨkka tu duukam na ba' gagai' jix koi na ja'p tu'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jup tɨɨt gu Siba tu duukam gu Sauul; gio ba' bɨx ka't gu Sauul bɨx gu vaak tu' jix maa gu mar gu Jawatan.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñga'n tu' bɨɨx gu ma'nkam tu duukam gu i'bhɨ na ba' gu mar gu Jawatan jix duñia' bɨɨx; gio ba' gu Mepi-boset gu mar gu Jawatan jugi bɨɨx tas gu takarui' gu vaak na jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr ga'ra' gu Siba gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook tu duukam.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Siba gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jurtu'nka' bɨx tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' tu duukam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Mepi-boset jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' jugi gu vaak na jix bhai' na ja'p maa'n gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu Mepi-boset gu mar jix ali' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Mikâ; gio ba' bɨx ja'tkam vaak gu vaak gu Siba jix duñia' tu duukam gu Mepi-boset.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Mepi-boset gu Jerusalem na gu' bɨɨx tas gu vaak na jix bhai' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' ka't jix bhai'x tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't jix koi gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu anuun gu mar.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx gu anuun gu mar gu Naas na ja'p gu taat jix duu; mi' dhɨr bhañ gu Dabii tu duukam gu ñi'ook gu taat; gu' tu duukam gu Dabii gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.

Jano' ba' chiñia' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gui'p gu anuun gu Jawatan; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu taat tu' nuukdaidha' cham tu' gu Dabii tu duukam tu' kiicham na ba' cham tu' duu.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu anuun jix bhɨɨ tu duukam gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jajannulhi'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx ka'm.

Na gu' na ja'p ka't gu ñi'ook maachim gu Dabii bhañ jix ai na gu' mi'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix duu gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Jerikoo bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' maaxilhia' jano' ba'.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Dabii mɨjɨ gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Siros gu vaak gu Reob gu Siros gu Soba gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ tɨɨt; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Maaka jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu Is-tob jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix kai gu Dabii bhañ gu Joab bɨɨx bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gamai' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ba'k ki'ñgob; gu' gu Siros gu Soba gu Reob gu Is-tob gu Maaka mi'p yooxi'.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Joab ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan kapbhai' bɨx gu Israeel jix dhaas bhaan gu Siros.
Jano' ba' do'ñcho gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu novɨ gu Abisai xibhɨk jix dhaas na ba' gu Ammonitas.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu Siros ua'tulhi'ñ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon tu' u'ua'tɨdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chulhiiñdha' gu ja'tkam jɨ'dɨlh chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Joab gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Siros; gu' jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon ñɨi'ñ gu Siros gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jiboi'ññor gio vupui bhaan gu Abisai baap kiicham; gio ba' gu Joab gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon suudai' u'va gu Jerusalem.
Gu' gu' ñɨi'ñ gu Siros gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Israeel gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu adad-eser jix buusñi gu Siros mi'p baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim tɨɨtɨs gu elam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sobak ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu adad-eser.
Jano' ba' na ja'p ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Dabii jum daa'ñ bɨx gu Israeel bhɨi gu Jordaan suudai' u'va gu elam; gio ba' gu Siros jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Dabii bɨɨx.

Gu' gu' gu Siros jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' naaka'n gu Dabii gu Siros gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oo'm jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ kavaayo; mi' dhɨr naaka'n gio gu Sobak ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix koi.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu adad-eser na ja'p jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Israeel jix duu bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Siros gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.

Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gɨgɨ'lhi'ñ gu gɨ'kora' bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Dabii bhañ gu Joab tu duukam bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Ammonitas jix dhaas jix duñia' gu Rabba; gu' gu Dabii gu Jerusalem.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨkbo gu Dabii gu tas gu xumai gu vaak vaak ja'tkam na pai' dhuuk jix ñi' dɨr gu u'vɨ ka't jix duñia' ka't gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Dabii tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ gui'p; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu Bat-seba mar u'vɨ gu Eliam gu u'vɨ gu Uriia gu eteo.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ; gio ba' ka't kia'mi'ñ jix koox bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ bhañ maachim gu Dabii bham; gio ba' tu' dhi'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joab; gio ba' gu Uriia gu eteo; mi' dhɨr bhañ gu Joab gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Uriia suudai' u'va tɨtda:―¿Jax gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tulhiiñdha' gu Joab tulhiiñdha' gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr gu Dabii gu Uriia; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak jix duñia' tɨɨt; mi' dhɨr gamai' gu Uriia gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' suudai' u'va bhaan jugi vaak ja'tkam.
Gu' gu' gu Uriia jix koox ki'ñgob gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx bɨx tu duukam gu Jawatan cham jix dhaav gu vaak.

Jano' ba' jix duu maachim dhi' gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu Uriia cham tu' jix duñia' gu vaak; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Dabii gu Uriia; jano' ba' cham tɨbiap gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak.

Jano' ba' gu Uriia jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' tu' gu Israeel gu Judaa bɨtaa'n vaak zel; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan gu Joab tu duukam gu Jawatan bhaan gu vupui yooxi'; jano' ba' ka't tu' baakɨi gu vaak na ba' jugi i'i koox bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gu Por gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu i'ii'ñ tu' cham jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Uriia; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu xibh tu'; mi' dhɨr gu Uriia gu Jerusalem mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh buimgidhak.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jugi i'i vupui bhaan bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix buus gu xumai koox bɨɨx tu duukam gu Jawatan; gu' cham jix dhaav gu vaak.
Jano' ba' namkia' gu xibh ua'na gu Dabii gu Joab gu ñi'ook bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Uriia.
Jano' ba' ua'na gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Uriia vupui bhaan gu kavɨk na ba' ka't.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu Joab gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham jix dhaas gu Uriia pai' bhai'x mi'p gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gamai' kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Joab ia'rɨ dhɨt gu ja'tkam tu duukam gu Dabii; gio ba' jix koi gio gu Uriia gu eteo.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' bhañ gu Joab tu' maachim gu Dabii bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix mattuda' bham; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' bɨx bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu gɨ'kora' kua'da' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook kiicham cham bhai'x gu ñi'ook vaak jodai.

Jano' ba' chɨkka naaka'n gu Abimelek gu mar gu Jerobaal cham jix duñia' gu u'vɨ vaak jodai gu ñi'ook jix koi gu Tebes gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vaak jodai; gio ba' jano' ba' tu' daipu'; mi' dhɨr gio tu duukam gu Uriia gu eteo jix koi.
Jano' ba' ka't mattuda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii bɨx tu'x gu Joab ka't.
Ba' jix aa' mattuda' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan no'ch gu chichio'ñ moor no'ch yooxi' xoi'kam no'ch bɨɨx ka'm ba'k ki'ñgob.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu duukam dɨr vaak jodai jix koko' dhɨt tu duukam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix koi gio tu duukam gu Uriia gu eteo.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii mattuda'; gio ba' daipu' gu Joab; mi' dhɨr cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu dhi' nɨidhim gu kuchii; jano' ba' bhaan kiicham bɨɨx ka'm; gio ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duu tɨiñ gu u'vɨ gu Uriia gu chio'ñ gu Uriia ka't jix koi gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhañ gu Dabii gu vaak; gio ba' ka't gu u'vɨ gu mar; gu' dhi' gu Dabii ka't gu ñi'ook ka't gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Enbioo gu Jawatan Dios gu Nataan gu Dabii bai'ñpu'; gio ba' ka't gook gu chichio'ñ kiicham maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gampai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ga'ra' kakneer.
Gu' gu' gampai' cham ga'ra' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ali' karneer ka't gu ñi'ook jix duñia' ka't bɨɨx gu ma'nkam bɨɨma'n jugi gu chin i'i vaaso kookos baaso; gio ba' ga'ra' na ja'p mar u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va maa'n gu bhóogɨt gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham jix bhɨɨ kakneer na ba' ka't tɨbiap gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ kaneer mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gampai' na ba' ka't tɨbiap.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'iich gu Dabii bhaan mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Nataan; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' jix duu suuska'n koi'm.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ali' karneer bɨɨx maakobh na gu' dhi' gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Nataan gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; jano' ba' gu Yo tu' gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel tu' gu novɨ gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' tu' gu vaak gu Jawatan gu u'vɨ gu Jawatan baaso; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu' gu vaak gu Israeel gu Judaa; mi' dhɨr tu' dhi' tu' tu'x.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios duñia' cham bhai' vupui bhaan gu vupui gu Uriia gu eteo gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' cham gu ñi'ook mɨɨjidha' gu vaak gu kuchii; na gu' gu u'vɨ gu Uriia gu eteo na ba' jum duu gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan tu' cham bhai' gu vaak gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu u'vɨ vupui bhaan gu vupui tɨtmo bɨɨx gu u'vɨ ñiata dhi' gu tas.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨxchuixim; gu' tu' dhi' vupui bhaan bɨx gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu tas.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Nataan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Nataan jix aa' gu Dabii; jano' ba' gio gu Jawatan Dios tu' uañi'ñ; gio ba' cham koi.
Na gu' gu' na gu' bɨɨx dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam obhɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu mar tu' maaxir koi gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Nataan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios naaka'n gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu Uriia ka't gu Dabii gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Dabii gu tukaa' jix duñia' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo daraa gu vaak jix bɨɨx duu na ba' jix duñia' jix búup gu oidha'; gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix jugi bɨɨx gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix koi gu ñi'ook; gu' tu duukam cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñia' maachim gu ñi'ook ka't jix koi bham tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' cham bhai' tu' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook jix koi.
Gu' gu' gu Dabii ñɨi'ñ tu duukam ñiokda' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't jix koi; gio ba' jix aa' gu Dabii tu duukam; mi' dhɨr jix koi gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jix koi.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix búup gu oidha' jix duñia' tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbiapui gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'; gio ba' mi' dhɨr suudai' u'va gu vaak jix dhaas gu takarui' jix jugi.
Jano' ba' gui'p tu duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Por gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jix koi gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' na jix do'ig gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bham; mi' dhɨr chɨkka tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' tu' gu tai gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' jano' tu' jix koi na ba' gu ñi'ook no'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu Bat-seba gu u'vɨ baakɨk jix koox bɨɨx; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Salomoon gu Jawatan Dios.
Na bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jedidia kuiñcha gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Joab gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Rabba gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon jix bhɨɨ kiicham vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bhañ gu Joab gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii bham; gio ba' tu' bhaan gu Rabba jix duñia' kiicham gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu ja'tkam yooxi' bhaan kiicham; na gu' dhaagɨk tu' kiicham cham gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't bhaan gu Rabba jix bhɨɨ.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ kuruun gu gɨ'kora' mo'o gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɨ' maa'nkar jodai jix uam jodai ga'ra' gu jodai a'bhar; gio ba' ka't jix duñia' bhaan mo'o gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' kiicham.

Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam ka't jix dhaas bɨtaa'n jix kavɨk jodai; gio ba' tu' jix duu gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duu bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; jano' ba' gu Dabii bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr dhi' ua'tulhdhidha' gu Absalom gu mar gu Dabii gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Tamar gu Amnoon gu mar gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Amnoon jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Tamar gu ja'tkam; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Amnoon duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Amnoon ga'ra' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jonadab gu mar gu Simea xibhɨk gu Dabii; gio ba' ka't gu Jonadab gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix maat.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu mar gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh cham tu' gu Amnoon jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Tamar gu ja'tkam gu Absalom xibhɨk.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jonadab; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka'ook; na pai' dhuuk gu taat daraibu'; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu Tamar na ba' bɨɨx jugi vupui bhaan tu' na ba' ñɨi'ñ tu' gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Amnoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't ka'ook suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia'; gio ba' jix aa' gu Amnoon gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr tu' soi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Tamar vupui bhaan tu' gook tu' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii bhañ gu Tamar gu vaak bham; gio ba' tu' jano' gu vaak gu Amnoon xibhɨk tu jiim jugi.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Tamar gu vaak xibhɨk gu Amnoon ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu' jix duu vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix buusñi vupui bhaan; gu' cham jugi; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Amnoon; jano' ba' mai' bɨx; gio ba' bɨx moor.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Amnoon gu Tamar; gio ba' jix duñia' jugi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' tu' gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr dhaagɨk gu Tamar ka't xibhɨk gu Amnoon.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix dhaas vupui bhaan na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix ai gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham xibhɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu kavɨk; na gu' cham tu' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; jano' ba' cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' na gu' duukat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨɨx tu' na ja'p maa'n gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duñia' jano' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' cham tu'.
Gu' gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' va'k jix duñia' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amnoon gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka't jix gɨ' xoi'kam bɨɨx ka't dha'; gio ba' jix aa' gu Amnoon; mi' dhɨr bamii'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jix gɨ' cham bhai' gu ñi'ook; gu' cham.
Ba' jix aa' va'k tɨɨt jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' mai' bhaan ki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' bhaan gu ñi'ook jix uam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' mai' jix duñia' ki'ñgob bhaan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Tamar jix bhɨɨ maatai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan mo'o jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix uam ka't gu noobh bhaan mo'o ka't.

Ba' jix aa' xibhɨk gu Absalom; gio ba' tu' dhi' bɨndak xibhɨk gu Amnoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr xibhɨk; jano' ba' cham gu i'ii'ñ dhi'; gio ba' gu Tamar gu vaak gu Absalom xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii jix kai bɨx dhi' ka't gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Absalom cham bɨɨx gu Amnoon tu' cham bhai' tu' jix bhai'; na gu' xoi'kam gu Absalom gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amnoon na gu' ka't gu Tamar gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook gu Absalom ga'ra' gu Bala-asor ju'ñdharan gu Epraim; gio ba' gu Absalom bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Absalom gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam juraa'n jano'; mi' dhɨr tu' soi'ñ gu gɨ'kora' tu duukam bɨɨx tu duukam.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Absalom; na gu' cham gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bɨx na gu' cham tu' jix duu gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx cham tu' gu' jix bhai' aa'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Absalom; gio ba' tu' cham jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx no'ch gu Amnoon xibhɨk; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; jano' ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook tu' bɨndak.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Absalom gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨɨx gu Amnoon bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Absalom jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham; gio ba' jano' xoi'kam gu ñi'ook duuk gu i'ii'ñ gu Amnoon jix bhai'x suudai' u'va tu ñi'ook tu' gu erid gu Amnoon jano' ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha'; na tu' jix duñia'; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Absalom jix duu bɨɨx gu Amnoon na ja'p gu Absalom ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' jix búup bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' bɨx jiboi'ññor.
Jano' ba' kua' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu Dabii chɨtda; gio ba' gu Absalom tu' jix koi bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' kɨkbo gu Dabii jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' bɨx jajannulhi'ñ mi'p vupui bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jonadab gu mar gu Simea xibhɨk gu Dabii; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan jix duñia' jix koi bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Amnoon jix koi; na gu' gu chin gu Absalom ka't gu ñi'ook dɨr gu tanoolh gu Amnoon gu Tamar gu ja'tkam.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' cham jix duñia' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' koko'kam; na gu' gu Amnoon jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu Absalom gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vupui ka't jix jai' gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu kavɨk.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jonadab gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' jupaabkamu'n; mi' dhɨr na ja'p tu duukam tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix bɨɨx duu ñiokda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' tɨɨtɨs gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gio gu gɨ'kora' bɨx tu duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt.
Gu' gu' gu Absalom gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Talmai gu mar gu Amiud gu gɨ'kora' gu Gessur; gio ba' gu Dabii gu mar bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu Absalom gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Gessur juruuñ vaik.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Absalom; na gu' tu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Amnoon ka't jix koi.
Jano' ba' jix maati' gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia gu i'ii'ñ gu gɨ'kora' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Absalom.
Ba' jix aa' bhañ gu Joab gu Tekoa jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ tu' cham tu' bɨɨx va'k tu' na ja'p gu u'vɨ tu' jix jai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix koi.
Jano' ba' baakɨk gu gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook bɨɨx dhi'; gio ba' jix dhaas gu Joab gu ñi'ook gu chin.
Ba' jix aa' chɨbiapui mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ gu Tekoa gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' bhaan gu vupui jix duu tu jiim; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' dodhia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' tu'r jix duñia' gu u'vɨ ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam gu chio'ñ jix koi.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam na tu juan ga'ra' gook gu ma'nkam gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi'; gio ba' cham dhaibu naaka'n maa'n.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx tu' jix duñia' bhaan ja'tkam na tu juan bham; gio ba' kapbhai' mu'aa xibhɨk na ba' jix duu koi gu oidha' xibhɨk mu'aa gio bi'ya'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' tu' jix duñia' cham gu chio'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' bhaan gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak tu' gu ñi'ook tu'.

Ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ gu Tekoa gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai' ka't bhaan tu' bhaan gu vaak gu taat; gu' gu gɨ'kora' atooxkor cham gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham tu' gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios cham mia'n gu ɨ'ɨr gu tanoolh na jix bhai' bɨɨx cham tu' duu gu mar; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' mo'o gu mar gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios a'gi'ñchu' gu gɨ'kora' dhi' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook na gu' gu gɨ'kora' cham gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' tɨɨda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu'ch na ja'p gu suudai' gu oidha' cham jɨ'xdha' jix duu; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' cham ka't.

Na gu' tu' tɨbiap jano' na ba' a'ga dhi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan na gu' gu ja'tkam tu' gu ñi'ook ɨɨbhi'ñ; gu' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook jano' gu gɨ'kora'; jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios.
Na gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu novɨ gu chio'ñ tu' gu mar bɨɨma'n gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' ja'tkam na tu juan tu ñi'ook; na ka't jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' na ba'; na gu' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' na ja'p nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix kai jix bhai' cham bhai'; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu u'vɨ jix aa'; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' cham tu' jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Joab bɨndak bɨx dhi' tu'x gu u'vɨ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tu' o'nsop bɨx gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' tu' tu ñi'ook; na gu' tu duukam gu Joab jix aa'ñdhix jix dhaas gu chin ja'tkam na tu juan bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' na jix uam duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Joab tu duukam tu' gu ñi'ook; gu' gu Jawatan jix bhai'x jurtu'nka' matda' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix maati' cham tu'x jai'ch gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Joab; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' dhi'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu vupui gu ñi'ook gu Absalom.

Ba' jix aa' gu Joab o'lhia'n gu oidha' bhaan gu vupui tu' jix duu tu jiim mi' dhɨr jix bhai' aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tu duukam gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' tu duukam tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Joab ka't gu Gessur gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Absalom gu Jerusalem.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak cham gu vupui; mi' dhɨr gu Absalom gu vaak cham jix ñi' gu vupui gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' cham ka't bɨx gu Israeel gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Absalom gu ñi'ook; gio ba' dɨr gu vaas tɨɨt bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ka't.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook oidha' tas gu ñi'ook mo'o vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Nakieeronle gu Absalom vaik gu ma'nkam mar u'vɨ jup tɨɨt gu Tamar ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' juruuñ gu Absalom gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gook gu Jerusalem cham jix ñi' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Absalom gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joab na ba' tɨip gu gɨ'kora'; gu' cham jix ai; mi' dhɨr tu' bhañ gookim jix duñia' jix ai.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' tu duukam; gio ba' xoi'kam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joab ju'ñdharan pai' juraa'n kai' vaas; mi' dhɨr gu tai; jano' ba' tu duukam gu Absalom gu tai.
Ba' jix aa' jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joab suudai' u'va gu Absalom gu vaak; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tai tu duukam.

Jano' ba' gu Absalom jix aa' gu Joab; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bham jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook tu' gu gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Gessur tutkɨ mai' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' tu' jano' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu' cham tu'x jai'ch tu' uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Joab gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maachim; gio ba' jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Absalom suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu vupui gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Absalom.
Jano' ba' jix duu ka't mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Absalom gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kavaayo mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Absalom gu xibh gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt ki'ñgob; gio ba' no'x ga'ra' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Absalom tɨɨt chɨtda; mi' dhɨr kiicham tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' tu duukam bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Absalom chɨtda; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix bhai'; gu' cham tu' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' chɨtda gu Absalom; gio ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bɨx bhai' gu oidha' na ba' tu' bɨx namki' gu ñi'ook tu' bɨx bhai'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' na ba' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' dhi' jix duñia' bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jir bhai'; gio ba' gu Absalom gu i'ii'ñ gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oo'm ka't gu Absalom gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ gu ebroon jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu na gu' tu duukam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Gessur gu Siria bham; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu' bhai'x i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr jix búup ka't gu ebroon.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook bhañ gu Absalom gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel bham; na pai' dhuuk kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk; mi' dhɨr gu Absalom gu ñi'ook gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx gu Absalom gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ gu Jerusalem koi'cham jix duñia' cham maachim cham tu'.
Jano' ba' gio bhañ gu Absalom gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Akitopel gu Gilonita gu Dabii gu Gilo kiicham jix duñia' makgɨrxi'ñdha'; gio ba' suudai' u'va jix gɨ' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu Absalom.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va aa'ñdham gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu Israeel tu' bhaan gu Absalom.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii bɨx tu duukam mi'p bɨɨx gu Jerusalem; na gu' jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' cham vupui bhaan gu Absalom; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jix duu cham ka't cham bhai' bhaan no'ch kiicham gu kuchii.
Jano' ba' tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' gui'p gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam bɨx chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jano' ba' jix buus bɨɨx bɨx ja'tkam vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' mambhɨɨx gu u'vɨ na ba' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook pai'.
Jano' ba' bɨx tu duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx gu Kereteos gu Peleteos; gio ba' bɨx gu Geteos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ tɨbiap tɨɨt dɨr gu Gat jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Ittai gu Geteo; gio ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gio bɨɨx no'ch bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' tu' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gio pai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook pai' na ba' tu' bɨɨx no'ch tu' na ja'p; gio ba' tu' gu vupui gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr tu' ka't xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Ittai gu gɨ'kora' bham; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' na ba' koi'm na ba' gu oidha' pai' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio tu duukam.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Ittai; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Ittai gu Geteo bɨx gu chichio'ñ bɨx ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam bhi'ñbak gu Kedroon; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt tu' oidha' jix gaki.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu Sadok bɨɨx bɨx gu Lebitas kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ gu Abiatar mi' dhɨr ka't gu ñi'ook kiicham bɨx gu ja'tkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Sadok; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios kiicham; na tu' bakia' nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr dhi' tu' xoi'kam.

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' cham tu' gu ñi'ook gu Bueelbete bhai'x i'ii'ñ kiicham; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gook gu ma'nkam gu mar gu Aimaas gu Jonataan gu mar gu Abiatar.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak ja'tkam oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook jix maa aa'ñdham.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Sadok gu Abiatar suulh kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix tɨ'ɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ joi'ndam mo'o iiñat tɨɨt jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr gio bɨx gu ja'tkam ga'ra' baidhak jix bhaan dhaas maa'n mo'o jix tɨ'ɨ joi'ndam na ja'p jix tɨ'ɨ.
Jano' ba' jix maa aa'ñdham gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu Absalom; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; jano' ba' jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Akitopel.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk na ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu usai gu Arakîta jix buus jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' bhaan mo'o.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.

Gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham tu ñi'ook gu Absalom; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu' jix duñia' tu duukam; mi' dhɨr na ja'p bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' tu duukam gu taat jix duñia' jano' tu duukam jano' ba' tu' gu Akitopel.
Jano' ba' cham no'm bɨndak gu Sadok gu Abiatar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Por gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' maa'n aa'ñdham gu Sadok gu Abiatar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gook gu ma'nkam gu Aimaas gu Sadok gu Jonataan gu Abiatar; gio ba' gu novɨ aa'ñdham bɨx.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu usai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii kiicham; gio ba' gu Absalom chɨbiapui gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Dabii gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gu Siba jix duñia' gu Mepi-boset busaak bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Siba; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu Siba jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook na ba' ja'tkam vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; jano' ba' gu takarui' na ba'; gio ba' suudai' u'va na ba' oidha' jix gaki.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' duukat gu mar gu Jawatan gu Siba jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu Jerusalem na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu taat.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Siba; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't bɨx juraa'n gu Mepi-boset; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Siba; jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook tu' nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bɨɨx ka'm gu Baurim; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam busaak maa'n ja'tkam vaak gu vaak gu Sauul gu Semei gu mar gu Gera; mi' dhɨr busaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai bhaan gu Dabii bhaan bɨx tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk mi'p kɨɨ'n.
Jano' ba' chɨtda gu Semei gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix buus gu chio'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr gu chio'ñ gu Belial.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ɨ'ɨr gu vaak gu Sauul pai' tu' gu gɨ'kora'; gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu novɨ gu mar gu Absalom; na gu' tu' na cham jir bhai' na gu' gu chio'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abisai gu mar gu Sarbia gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gagai' jix koi gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' tu' soi'ñ gu ñi'ook mo'o.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; na gu' gu Kuee no'ñ tu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Sarbia gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr chɨkka; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Abisai bɨx tu duukam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar tu' gu ñi'ook ba'k gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr jano' gu mar gu Benjamiin gu Dejadle gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios maa'n gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu Semei gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk vupui bhaan jiim jix duñia' gu jodai vupui bhaan oo'.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Absalom bɨx gu ja'tkam gu chio'ñ gu Israeel baap gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu Akitopel.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu usai gu Arakîta gu Dabii ka't gu ñi'ook gu Absalom gu usai; gio ba' gu tai gu gɨ'kora' gu tai gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Absalom gu usai; gio ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook cham bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu usai jix aa' gu Absalom; gio ba' cham; mi' dhɨr va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu ja'tkam bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Israeel jix duñia' tu' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' chɨkka ka't tu' tu juan cham gu mar na ja'p jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu taat jix duñia' vupui bhaan tu'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Absalom gu Akitopel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook chulhiiñchuda'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Akitopel gu Absalom; gio ba' ba'k gu u'vɨ gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' nukadham gu vaak; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Israeel tu' gu ñi'ook gu taat jix duñia' gu noobh bɨx bɨndak.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix dhaas vaak zel gu Absalom bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbiapui gu Absalom gu u'vɨ gu taat gu vupui bɨx gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Akitopel mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh ka't na ja'p tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' ka't gu Akitopel bɨɨx gu Dabii na ja'p bɨɨx gu Absalom.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Akitopel gu Absalom; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu Dabii dhi' gu tukaa'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu noobh; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam tu'; na pai' dhuuk mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ tu' bɨx gu ja'tkam bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam gu Absalom bɨx daraa gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Absalom; gio ba' mɨmɨim gio jano' gu usai gu Arakîta na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu usai suudai' u'va gu Absalom bham; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Akitopel; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu usai gu Absalom; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix maa dhi' jix duñia' gu Akitopel cham jix bhai'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu usai; na pai' dhuuk tu' ñɨidhat gu taat gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk bɨɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim na ja'p yooxi' na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam; mi' dhɨr gu taat gu chio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham cham gu tukaa' bɨɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu jodai' na jix uam jumpa'n pai'; gio ba' tu' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam dhɨt jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam gu Absalom tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ jix kavɨk gu i'ii'ñ ka't na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ maavɨt cham jix duñia'; na gu' bɨx gu Israeel gu taat gu chio'ñ jix kavɨk bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Israeel tu' dɨr gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu Beer-seba na ja'p oo' jugii'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' tu' gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' bakia' bhaan na ja'p na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oidha' tu' maa'n bɨx bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham bɨx gu Israeel gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr kiicham gu ko' na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx ka'm jix duu cham pai' dhuuk gu jodai.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Absalom bɨx gu Israeel gui'p; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu usai gu Arakîta tutkɨ gu Akitopel; na gu' ka't gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Akitopel na ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix ai cham bhai' bhaan gu Absalom.
Ba' jix aa' gu usai gu Sadok gu Abiatar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Akitopel gu Absalom daraa gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam aa'ñdham gu Dabii bham; na gu' cham dhi' gu tukaa' vaak ja'tkam oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan na gu' gu gɨ'kora' cham ka't bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx.

Na gu' gu Jonataan gu Aimaas mi'p ju'ñdharan suudai' buusñi gu Rogel na gu' cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bai'ñpu' kiicham; gio ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios jix maa aa'ñdham; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa jix duñia' gu Absalom; gu' cham gu ñi'ook gook jix maa jiim gu vaak gu chio'ñ gu Baurim ga'ra' gu ñi'ook naadat gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhaagɨk gu u'vɨ gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu chin gu ñi'ook bhaan kai'ñ; gio ba' cham.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Absalom gu vaak gu u'vɨ gui'p; gio ba' duukat gu Aimaas gu Jonataan gu u'vɨ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu suudai'; jano' ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook suulh gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr a'lhiok gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' moor gu ñi'ook jix bɨɨx duu jix maa aa'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii; gio ba' gui'p; na gu' jix búup jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' na gu' gu Akitopel tu' jix maa jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix búup bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' maa'n cham gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan.

Jano' ba' gu Akitopel ñɨi'ñ cham ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam gu ñi'ook jix búup ka't gu vaak kiicham; gio ba' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu vaak jix koi ka't jix duñia' tukga'n gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Maanaim gu Absalom gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu Absalom gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amasa bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham pai' gu Joab gu Amasa ka't gu mar gu chio'ñ gu Israeel tɨɨgim gu Itra ka't kia'mi'ñ gu Abigail mar u'vɨ gu Naas gu ja'tkam gu Sarbia gu naan gu Joab.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' gu Israeel bɨɨx gu Absalom gu oidha' gu Galaad.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Maanaim gu Sobi gu mar gu Naas gu Rabba gu ma'nkam gu Ammon gu Makîr gu mar gu Ammiel gu Lodebar gu Barsillai gu Galaadita gu Rogelim.
Jano' ba' aichdhak gu Dabii gu ja'tkam ka't bɨɨx Cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhi'ñ tiriik kai' vaas kai'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer na ba'; na gu' gui'p; mi' dhɨr mii' dhɨr gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam ga'ra' baidhak jix dhaas bhaan bopxi'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n gu ja'tkam gu Joab gu Abisai gu mar gu Sarbia xibhɨk gu Joab baasɨ'n gu Ittai gu Geteo; gio ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr tu' gio bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' tu' no'ch cham jix duu no'ch; jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch cham jix duu no'ch; gu' tu' jano' jix duñia' na ja'p mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x no'ch; mi' dhɨr ka't tutkɨ tu' u'ua'tɨdham dɨr kiicham.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' ba'k ki'ñgob busaak bɨx gu ja'tkam chamaam jix bhai'x.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'ñdhix gu Joab gu Abisai gu Ittai bham; gio ba' gu Tratad gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam tu' gu Absalom; na pai' dhuuk bɨx gu ja'tkam jix kai na pai' dhuuk jix maa gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu Absalom bɨx.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu ja'tkam yooxi' bhaan gu Israeel jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Epraim.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu Israeel vupui bhaan tu duukam gu Dabii tu' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu vupui bɨx gu oidha' jix bɨɨx duu gu ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Absalom bɨɨx tu duukam gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' gu Absalom bhaan gu ñi'ook chɨbiapui bɨtaa'n jix gɨ' mo'o tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'; na gu' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu Joab bham; gio ba' buupui gu Absalom.
Jano' ba' gu Joab jix aa' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' gu oidha' bhaan tu' jix maa mambhɨɨx jix toja jodai.

Ba' jix aa' gu chio'ñ gu Joab; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh jix bhai'x jix toja jodai cham tu' gu novɨ bhaan gu mar gu gɨ'kora'; na pai' dhuuk na gu' no'ch na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' tu' jix aa'ñdhix tu' gu Abisai gu Ittai bham; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Absalom.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oidha' gu gɨ'kora' cham tu' tu' dhi' bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Joab; gio ba' cham gu i'ii'ñ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr dhaagɨk vaik gu noobh gu i'ii'ñ gu Absalom ka't gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx biipibop kutun kavɨk gu Joab gu Absalom jix bɨɨx duu.
Na gu' jano' ba' gu Joab gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Israeel na gu' gu Joab gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' dhaagɨk mi' dhɨr gu Absalom jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix búup bhaan gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' gɨ' kavɨk gu jodai; gio ba' bɨx gu Israeel maa'n dhi'.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Absalom gu oidha' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' ka't tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' cham no'ñ gu mar chɨ'ñchoka' gu tɨɨgɨ'; jano' ba' jup tɨɨt mii' dhɨr gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' jup tɨɨt pai' gu Absalom bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Aimaas gu mar gu Sadok; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' kuiñcha gu novɨ obhɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Joab; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh; na gu' cham maa'n gu ñi'ook jix duñia' na gu' gu mar gu gɨ'kora' jix koi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Joab gu Kusi; gio ba' tu' gu gɨ'kora' buupui; mi' dhɨr gu Kusi jix duu tu jiim gu Joab dai'bus.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Aimaas gu mar gu Sadok gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'ga gu Joab; gio ba' ka't ua'tulhi'ñ tu' jano' bhaan gu Kusi; mi' dhɨr gu Joab jix aa'; jano' ba' gu mar na ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' cham bakia' gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' jix aa'; gio ba' ka't ua'tulhi'ñ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix aa'; jano' ba' jix duñia'; gio ba' dai'bus gu Aimaas gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Kusi.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Dabii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daakat tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook kiki'ñgob; gio ba' ka't bhaan ki'ñgob vaak jodai gu vupui jix ñi' maa'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa jiiñak tu' maachim gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia'; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix maa jiiñak gu ñi'ook bham; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ jix duñia'; jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; gio ba' gio mattuda'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'ga; gio ba' maa'n na ja'p gu Aimaas gu mar gu Sadok; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; jano' ba' gu chio'ñ xoi'kam jupaabkamu'n bɨɨx jix bhai'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Aimaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; jano' ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu noobh bhaan gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Absalom juraa'n bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Aimaas jix aa'; na pai' dhuuk tu' jix gɨ' gu jodai' na jix uam na pai' dhuuk bhañ gu Joab tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' tu' tu duukam; gu' cham tu' gu ñi'ook ka't.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Kusi; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' kuiñcha gu novɨ bɨx jix duñia' bhaan tu'.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' jano' ba' gu Kusi; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Absalom juraa'n bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Kusi jix aa'; mi' dhɨr na ja'p mii' dhɨr ka't obhɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' bɨx bhaan tu' na ba' cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix tɨ'ɨ ki'ñgob; gio ba' jiimchu' chɨtda; mi' dhɨr gu mar gu Absalom gu mar gu Absalom gu Kuieen vaak jodai tu' pai' tu' gu Absalom gu mar.
Jano' ba' jix maa aa'ñdham gu Joab; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu Absalom.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh na ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam; na gu' jix kai gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu gɨ'kora' ga'ra' gu mar.
Jano' ba' chɨbiapui gu ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p baakɨi gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia'.
Gu' gu' gu gɨ'kora' jix bhaan dhaas gu vupui tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu mar gu Absalom gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' baakɨk gu Joab gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu vupui bɨx tu duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ pai' gu u'vɨ pai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; na gu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' cham tu' tu' chiñia' tu duukam; na gu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu Absalom xoi'kam no'ch bɨx gu ñi'ook koko'kam jano' ba' tu'.
