Jano' ba' bamii' jano' gu ñi'ook mai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' cham tu' maa'n jix duñia' bɨndak dhi' gu tukaa'; mi' dhɨr dhi' tu' bɨx tu' jix duñia' daam dɨr bɨɨx ka'm jano'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup gu gɨ'kora' jix daa ki'ñgob; gio ba' ka't jix duñia' bɨx gu ja'tkam bham; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' daakat ki'ñgob; jano' ba' suudai' u'va bɨx gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'; gu' gu Israeel ka't jix duñia' maa'n dhi'.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu' gu novɨ tu' dodhia' gu novɨ gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr jano' ka't jix duñia' gu oidha' ɨɨbhi'ñ gu Absalom.
Jano' ba' gu Absalom dua'ñ Xoi'kam bhaan no'ch jix koi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jano' a'ga gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bhañ gu Sadok gu Abiatar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bham; gio ba' gu ablad daraa gu Judaa ja'xñi; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook boopoya' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak tu' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu Israeel tu' tɨbiap gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' o'oo gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook boopoya' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amasa; gio ba' cham tu' gio o'o gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios tu' cham ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham vupui bhaan tu' na ba' bɨɨx tas pai' gu Joab.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Judaa na ja'p gu chio'ñ na ba' a'ga gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu' bɨx tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' suudai' u'va bɨɨx ka'm gu Jordaan; gio ba' gu Judaa suudai' u'va gu Gilgal gu gɨ'kora' jix jiim gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' gu Semei gu mar gu Gera gu mar gu Benjamiin ka't gu Baurim jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ai bɨɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Judaa gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx aajidha' mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ gu Benjamiin; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Siba jix duñia' gu vaak gu Sauul bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu Jordaan vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' ja'tkam vaak gu gɨ'kora' na ba' gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk jano' ba' gu Semei gu mar gu Gera o'lhia'n vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Jordaan.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan tu' na cham jir bhai' tu' chɨ'ñchoka' tu duukam jix duu gu tanoolh gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' jix buus gu Jerusalem na ba' nukadham gu gɨ'kora' gu i'ii'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu duukam kakasnira' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ tɨbiap gu ñi'ook maa'n bɨx gu vaak gu Josee na ba' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abisai gu mar gu Sarbia; gio ba' cham tu' koi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu Semei Xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jano' ba'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam namki' gu ma'nkam gu Sarbia jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' koi gu ñi'ook oi'ñdha' gu Israeel cham kakasnira' tu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Semei; gio ba' cham koi; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' gio gu Mepi-boset gu mar gu Sauul jix dhaav gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' cham ka't tooton tɨɨt tu' ka't gu ñi'ook tu' ka't tooton jajannulhi'ñ dɨr gu tanoolh gu gɨ'kora' jix buus bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh suudai' u'va bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Mepi-boset cham.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam tu'; na gu' ka't tu duukam tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' buur tu' tu jiim gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' tu duukam jix bhai'x.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'; gu' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' na ja'p nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu vupui xoi'kam tu'.
Na gu' na gu' bɨx gu vaak gu taat ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koi'm vupui bhaan gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' tu' tu duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ koi'cham meesa; gio ba' gu ñi'ook no'ñ na ba' bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' tu' gu Siba.
Ba' jix aa' gu Mepi-boset gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' tu' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gio gu Barsillai gu Galaadita jix dhaav gu Rogelim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jordaan bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' na ba' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Barsillai gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jix maa gu gɨ'kora' na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Maanaim na gu' ka't gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Barsillai; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jugi gu Jerusalem.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Barsillai gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu oidha' na ba' tu' bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x tu' cham tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai' cham bhai'; gio ba' jano' tu duukam tu jiim gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam gu Jordaan bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kimam tu' bɨɨx na ja'p xoi'kam tu'; mi' dhɨr bɨx tu'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' ka't gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Barsillai jix bhai' aa'; mi' dhɨr gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Gilgal bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Kimam; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Judaa bɨɨx tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Israeel tɨɨtɨs gu gɨ'kora' gui'p; gio ba' gu chichio'ñ gu Judaa gu ja'tkam tu' jix duñia' baabuk jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan gu gɨ'kora' ja'tkam vaak bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Dabii bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Judaa tu ñi'ook bɨx gu Israeel; na gu' gu gɨ'kora' chulhiiñdha' jir bɨx bhai'; gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook no'ch gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' dho'ñchidhak.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Israeel gui'p gu Judaa; gio ba' no'ch tañia' gu gɨ'kora' mambhɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duñia' cham a'aixkam no'ch maa'n chulhiiñdha' gu gɨ'kora' gu chio'ñ gu Judaa ka't jix kavɨk gu chio'ñ gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel oi'ñchu' gu Seba gu mar gu Bikri; gu' gu Judaa jix bɨɨx duu gu gɨ'kora' dɨr gu Jordaan bɨɨx ka'm gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu vaak gu Jerusalem jix bhɨɨ gu gɨ'kora' mambhɨɨx gu u'vɨ ka't tɨtda:―Cha'pim na ba' nukadham gu vaak jix dhaas gu vaak jix nukadham jix maa jugi; gu' cham pai' dhuuk chɨbiapui gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm jix koko' gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Amasa; gio ba' gu Juuntame gu chio'ñ gu Judaa na ba' gu ñi'ook vaik gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Amasa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa; gu' gu ñi'ook ka't jix duñia' nɨi'ñchudat.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Abisai; gio ba' gu Seba gu mar gu Bikri gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' cham bhai' gu Absalom; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ tu' tu duukam gu Jawatan tu' bhaan cham ka't gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' moor gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ gu Joab gu Kereteos gu Peleteos bɨx jix kavɨk; gio ba' moor gu Jerusalem na ba' tu' bhaan gu Seba gu mar gu Bikri.
Jano' ba' kua' mia'n jix gɨ' jodai kavɨk gu Gabaoon jix buus gu Amasa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jano' xoi'kam kutun gu Joab ga'ra' daam bhaan gu ñi'ook na ja'p.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Joab gu Amasa; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai'x i'ii'ñ xibhɨk jix bhɨɨ gu Joab bɨɨx kɨɨ'n gu Amasa na ba'.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Amasa cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joab gu novɨ ga'ra' naaka'n bɨɨx ja'aa ba'k gu oidha' jix koi cham nukadham gook gu ñi'ook; gio ba' mi' dhɨr gu Joab xibhɨk gu Abisai jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gu Seba gu mar gu Bikri.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joab gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan bham; gio ba' no'x gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Joab gu Dabii gu Joab.

Jano' ba' gu Amasa ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt; na gu' ñɨi'ñ mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jix ai'chdhix gu Amasa gu bhóogɨt yooxi' jix duñia' bhaan kutun na gu' bɨx aajidha' gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bɨx oi'ñchu' gu Joab na ba' tu' bhaan gu Seba gu mar gu Bikri.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel bɨɨx ka'm gu Abel gu Bet-maakâ bɨx gu Barim; gio ba' jum daa'ñ bhiadat gio.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abel gu Bet-maakâ jix dhaas bhaan kiicham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't vaak jodai bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't bɨɨx gu Joab vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa jiiñak kiicham bham; gio ba' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu Joab jix bhai'x na ba' tu' tu ñi'ook bɨɨx.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Joab jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia'; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñiokda' bham; gio ba' gu tas ñiokda' bham; na tu ñi'ook gu Abel; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' cham tu' duu kiicham gu naan gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Joab jix aa' bham; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham; gu' gu chio'ñ gu kavɨk gu Epraim mɨmɨim gu Seba gu mar gu Bikri tu' jix duñia' gu novɨ bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr kapbhai' tu jiim kiicham; jano' ba' gu u'vɨ jix aa' gu Joab; gio ba' mo'o tu' ka't jix duñia' dɨr vaak jodai.

Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ ka't bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx matda'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook mo'o gu Seba gu mar gu Bikri jix duñia' gu Joab; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook kiicham maa'n dhi'; jano' ba' gu Joab gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joab bhaan bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada bhaan gu Kereteos gu Peleteos.
Jano' ba' gu Adoram bhaan bopxi'ñ; gio ba' gu Josapat gu mar gu Aillud gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Seba gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Sadok gu Abiatar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Ira gu Jaireo ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam mia'n gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu Seba gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Sadok gu Abiatar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Ira gu Jaireo ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam mia'n gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu Dabii ka't bhiogi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik; gio ba' gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Sauul mii' dhɨr gu vaak gu ɨ'ɨr; na gu' gu Gabaonitas.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jup tɨɨt gu Gabaonitas; gio ba' gu Gabaonitas cham jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amorreos gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook; gu' gu Sauul ka't kooda' bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Judaa; jano' ba'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Gabaonitas; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na ba' gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Gabaonitas tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham tañia' no'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jix toja jodai tu' bhaan jix uam jodai bɨɨx gu Sauul bɨɨx gu vaak; mi' dhɨr tu' gu chio'ñ gu Israeel; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan no'ch na ba' cham cham tu' no'ch bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam na ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Gabaa gu Sauul gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Mepi-boset gu mar gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sauul gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Dabii gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sauul.

Gu' gu' jix bhɨɨ gu gɨ'kora' gook gu ma'nkam gu Rispa mar u'vɨ gu Aja ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sauul maachim gu Armoni gu Mepi-boset; gio ba' jixchamaam gu ma'nkam gu Mikâl mar u'vɨ gu Sauul ka't gu Adriel gu mar gu Barsillai gu Molatita.

Jano' ba' do'ñcho gu noobh gu Gabaonitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix koko' tɨtda:―Aañ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam kɨɨv jix bɨɨx duu koko'kam gu ñi'ook oraa' dharka' gu tanoolh gɨ'kora' ja'tkam oraa' kai' vaas.

Jano' ba' dhaagɨk gu Rispa mar u'vɨ gu Aja gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu jodai' na jix uam dɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam oraa' bɨɨx ka'm bhaan gu suudai' gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' cham matgɨm gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr bhaan gu tanoolh tu' gu vaakax yooxi' gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Dabii jix duñia' gu Rispa mar u'vɨ gu Aja gu u'vɨ gu Sauul.

Na pai' dhuuk jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't jix bhɨɨ o'oo gu Sauul o'oo gu Jonataan gu mar gu chichio'ñ gu Jabes gu Galaad gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨrban gu Bet-san pai' gu Pilisteos na pai' dhuuk gu Pilisteos gu Sauul gu Gilboa.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam o'oo gu Sauul o'oo gu Jonataan gu mar; gio ba' jum daa'ñ gio o'oo.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook o'oo gu Sauul gu mar gu Jonataan gu oidha' gu Benjamiin gu Sela tukga'n gu Kis gu taat; gio ba' tu' jix duu bɨx gu gɨ'kora' ka't jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Pilisteos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel jix dhaav gu Dabii tu duukam bɨɨx gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu Isbi-benob ka't gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'u kavɨk ka't vaik gu jodai' na jix uam ga'ra' gu kuchii gu ñi'ook gu Dabii.

Gu' gu' gu Abisai gu mar gu Sarbia gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' naaka'n gu Pilisteo; gio ba' jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu Dabii gu ñi'ook bham; na gu' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' bɨɨx no'ch na gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gookim bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't mi' dhɨr gu Gob bhaan gu Pilisteos; gio ba' jano' ba' gu Sibekâi gu usatita naaka'n gu Sap ka't gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't gu Gob bhaan gu Pilisteos gu Elanan gu mar gu Jaare-oregim gu Bet-leem naaka'n gu Goliat gu Geteo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'u kavɨk ka't na ja'p.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Gat pai' ka't gu chio'ñ jix gɨ' jix duñia' ga'ra' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh tɨɨt maakob bɨx; gio ba' gio ka't gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sima xibhɨk gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam maakobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maaxir gu ñi'ook gu Gat ia'rɨ gu novɨ gu Dabii gu novɨ tu duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook dhi' bhai' ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ gu novɨ gu Sauul.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jodai kavɨk gu kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' na jix uam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tulhiiñdha' gu kavɨk; mi' dhɨr boosolh gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios suuska'n jix duñia' obhɨɨ'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koi'm tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koi'm.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix kai gu ñi'ook dɨr vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook maatɨt.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu tɨkɨr jix bɨɨx duu na gu'.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ kuubh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chin gu tai jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr jix dhaav; gio ba' gu tukgam bɨtaa'n tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu ñi'ook da'a; gio ba' jix ñi'ñ bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jɨvɨl.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu tukgam xikoolh ga'n; gio ba' gu suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨbaa'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu tɨkɨr gu Altiisimo jix maa gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai' oipichu' jix bɨɨx duu gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ daak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ jix bhai'x jix buusñi gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix kavɨk obhɨɨ'ñ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh; gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' jix dhaas aagak tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' bɨx bhai'; gio ba' jurtu'nka' gu noobh jix maa.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios cham gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' vupui bhaan tu' no'ñ bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx bhai' na ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' bɨx bhai' jurtu'nka' vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx bhai' tu' bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bɨɨx gu' bɨɨx jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gu' gu vupui bhaan na ba' tu jiim.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu tasi' gu tukgam.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chugi'ñ bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios gu ta'm na tu maakia' gu Dios vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chɨkka jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Na gu ñi'ook gu noobh na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' chɨɨdak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tulhiiñdha' tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨtaa'n tu' na ba' cham kɨkbok.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam obhɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' cham bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix búup; gio ba' bɨtaa'n tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk na ba' bɨtaa'n tu' bhaan tu' jix búup.
Jano' ba' tu' chɨɨdak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam obhɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu' cham jix aa'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p oo' gu oidha'; gio ba' na ja'p.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' na ba' jum duu mo'o chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' tɨiñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tai gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' na jix uam dodhia'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ja'tkam bɨtaa'n tu'.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi tɨjɨɨ'ñ obhɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu' jix buusñi jix bhai'x tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix búup bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tulhiiñdha' gu gɨ'kora' duñia' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu kai' na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Dabii; gio ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu mar gu Isaii mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ ka't jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' nɨɨn.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' tu ñi'ook jix kavɨk gu Israeel; gio ba' aapi' gu chichio'ñ ka't jir bhai' aapi' choo'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na ja'p gu tasi' gu xibh na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tas gu xibh cham tɨbaa'ñ; na pai' dhuuk gu vaas gu oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ mi' dhɨr dhuuk.

Jano' ba' cham gu vaak na ba' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios; gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan jix duñia' bɨx tu'x ka't; mi' dhɨr xoi'kam bɨx dhi' tulhiiñdha' bɨx gu ñi'ook cham.
Gu' gu' gu Belial ka't bɨx na ja'p jo'ii' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam soo'mchulhdhak jix bhɨɨ bɨɨx gu novɨ.
Gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuichdha' jix kavɨk jodai u'u kavɨk pai'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' jix kavɨk jix duñia' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Takmonita gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr ka't gu Adino gu Esnita bua' bhaan gu chichio'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Eleasar gu mar gu Dodo gu Aoi ka't vaik jix kavɨk mi'p bɨɨx gu Dabii na pai' dhuuk gu Pilisteos gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' dhi' kɨkbo naaka'n gu Pilisteos bɨɨx ka'm gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kuchii; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios jix duu tulhiiñdha'; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Samma gu mar gu Age gu Araita; na gu ñi'ook gu Pilisteos ka't gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam ka't jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' tu' naaka'n gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu tulhiiñdha'.
Jano' ba' vaik gu ñi'ook jix dhaav tɨɨtɨs gu ñi'ook oraa' gu Dabii jumpa'n gu Adullam; gio ba' yooxi' gu Pilisteos ka't gu ñi'ook gu Rapaim.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jano' ba' ka't gu kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pilisteos ka't gu Bet-leem.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'i gu suudai' gu Bet-leem ki'ñgob.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' vaik jix kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' gu Pilisteos jix duñia' gu suudai' gu Bet-leem ka't ki'ñgob; gio ba' aichdhak gu Dabii; gu' cham i'i gu ñi'ook ja'aa gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhi'; gio ba' i'i tu' gu ɨ'ɨr gu chio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx gu oidha' cham i'i; mi' dhɨr vaik jix kavɨk jix duu dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu Abisai xibhɨk gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam vaik; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'u kavɨk bhaan vaik; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vaik maa'n; gu' cham vaik dharka'.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada gu mar gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ' gu Kabseel; gio ba' dhi' naaka'n gook gu Moab; mi' dhɨr jix dhaav tu' naaka'n maavɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jabook.
Jano' ba' gio naaka'n gu Egipkio gu chio'ñ jix gɨ' dhi'; gio ba' ga'ra' gu Egipkio u'u kavɨk gu novɨ; gu' jix dhaav bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Egipkio u'u kavɨk gu novɨ mu'aa bɨɨx u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix duu dhi' gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gu' cham vaik dharka'; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu Asael xibhɨk gu Joab ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Elaanan gu mar gu Dodo gu Bet-leem.
Jano' ba' gu Samma gu arodi gu Elika gu arodi.
Jano' ba' gu eles gu Palti gu ira gu mar gu Jekkes gu Tekoa.
Jano' ba' gu Abieser gu Anatot gu Mebunnai gu usa.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ao gu Maarai gu Netopat.
Jano' ba' gu elek gu mar gu Baana gu Netopat gu Ittai gu mar gu Ribai gu Gabaa gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' gu Benaiia gu Piratonita gu iddai jix duu gu Gaas.
Jano' ba' gu Abi-albon gu Arbat gu Asmabet gu Barum.
Jano' ba' gu Eliaba gu Saalboon gu Jonataan gu ma'nkam gu Jasseen.
Jano' ba' gu Samma gu Arar gu Aiam gu mar gu Sarar gu Arar.
Jano' ba' gu Elipelet gu mar gu Asbai gu mar gu Maakâti; gio ba' gu Eliam gu mar gu Akîtopel gu Geloon.
Jano' ba' gu esrai gu Karmelo gu Parai gu Arbi.
Jano' ba' gu Igeal gu mar gu Nataan gu Soba gu Bani gu Gadi.
Jano' ba' gu Selek gu Ammoon gu Naarai gu Beerot kutun kavɨk gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia.
Jano' ba' gu Ira gu Itri gu Gareb gu Itri.
Jano' ba' gu Uriia gu eteo; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' gu Bolbioo i'iich gu Jawatan Dios jix duu bhaan gu Israeel tu' jix duñia' gu Dabii bhaan tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Israeel gu Judaa.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Joab gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham ga'ra' baidhak; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel dɨr gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu Beer-seba gu ja'tkam na ba' tu' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu Joab jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook mui'kim na ja'p gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'; gu' na ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joab ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' jix buus gu Joab bɨɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' na ba' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' bhɨi gu Jordaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aroer gu novɨ tu jiim kiicham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Gad ju'ñdharan gu Jaser.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr tɨɨtɨs gu Galaad gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Absi; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Dan-jaaan xikoolh gu Sidoon.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu kavɨk gu Tiro bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu ebeos gu Kananeos; gio ba' moor saagi'ñ gu Judaa gu Beer-seba.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr a'lhiok gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu oidha' suulh gu Jerusalem gu ñi'ook masaa'n gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' gu Joab jix maa jix duñia' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk jix duñia' gu kuchii; mi' dhɨr gu Judaa jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu Dabii ka't jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Yo uañi'ñ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook dhi'; na gu' gu' jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' uañi'ñ tu duukam na gu' tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii ka't jix duñia' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Gad jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu Dabii bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr vaik tu'x tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; jano' ba' tu'.

Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Gad gu Dabii tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' kɨɨv bhiogi' gu oidha' vaik masaa'n vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' vaik gu tanoolh ka't gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Piensa jano' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook tu'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Gad; gio ba' jix gɨ' jix duñia' dhi'; na gu' soi'ñ jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mumua'da' cham jix duñia' tu' gu noobh gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Israeel dɨr gu xibh bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook nɨi'ñchudat; gio ba' jix koko' gu ja'tkam dɨr gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu Beer-seba gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p nobii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bhaan gu Jerusalem na ba' cham tu' duu gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr cham bhai' nobii'ñ gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jix duñia' jano'; mi' dhɨr gu novɨ; jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't ju'ñdharan ka't gu Arauna gu Jebuseo.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk jix ñi' nobii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Yo tu' tu' na cham jir bhai'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duu dhi' kakneer gu Rueegote gu novɨ bhaan tu' bhaan gu vaak gu taat.
Ba' jix aa' gu Gad suudai' u'va gu Dabii mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; gio ba' jix duñia' gu vupui jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Arauna gu Jebuseo.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Dabii jurtu'nka' tu ñi'ook gu Gad gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tɨɨgɨk gu Arauna jix ñi' gu gɨ'kora' tu duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gamai' jano' ba' gu Arauna gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Arauna; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jupaabkamu'n gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' tu duukam gu Dabii jix aa'; na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' ka't na ba' gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Arauna gu Dabii; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr gu vaakax na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan; jano' ba' gu vaakax na ba' gu u'u.
Jano' ba' bɨx jix maa na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu Arauna gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix aa' gu Arauna gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't jix duñia'.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Arauna; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'uuk tu'; na gu' cham gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan cham tu'; jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't gu vaakax mambhɨɨx jix toja jodai.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Dabii jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu oidha' jix utu'ñ gu Israeel.
